# REPLAY-2: A retired replay field keeps its place, and its meaning is never reused

- A field the EKF no longer reads stays in its struct, renamed `unused`, so later fields keep their offsets. It is never given a new meaning, because older logs still carry the old one.

Confirmed 2026-11-14. Part of the AP_NavEKF3 playbook, under [Data Abstraction Layer (DAL) and EKF Replay](../claude/libraries/AP_NavEKF3/CLAUDE.md#data-abstraction-layer-dal-and-ekf-replay). [All rules](../README.md#architectural-rules)
